title: A rigorously characterized I3322 quantum wall and finite-dimensional nonattainment
description: The tensor-product and commuting-operator suprema of the canonical I3322 Bell functional are identified with a rigorously characterized domain-wall constant, and neither model has a finite-dimensional maximizer. Consequently C_q(3,3;2,2) is nonclosed. A separate Jordan--Schmidt--Caratheodory argument proves that every bipartite binary-output scenario with at most two inputs on either side is compact, making the 3-by-3 scenario minimal by input counts. The release includes two independently implemented interval reconstructions and exact analytic audits.
